repo.description:
### Impact

A bug in the permission logic allowed users with "Can share" permission to modify the permissions of other recipients.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Deck app is upgraded to 1.14.6 or 1.15.2

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3247499)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/deck/pull/7131)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Deck app allowed user with "Can share" permission to modify permissions of other non-owners
